local function v19()
	local v20 = LocalPlayer
	local t3 = { v20.FindFirstChild(v20, "Backpack"), Character, ReplicatedStorage }
	local t4 = {}
	local n1 = 0

	for _, v in ipairs(t3) do
		if v then
			for _, descendant in ipairs(v.GetDescendants(v)) do
				if not t4[descendant] then
					t4[descendant] = true

					if descendant:IsA("NumberValue") or (descendant:IsA("IntValue") or descendant:IsA("FloatValue")) then
						local v28 = descendant.Name:lower()

						if v28:find("recoil") or (v28:find("spread") or (v28:find("bloom") or (v28:find("deviation") or (v28:find("kick") or v28:find("sway"))))) then
							if pcall(function()
								descendant.Value = 0
							end) then
								n1 = n1 + 1
							end
						elseif v28:find("accuracy") and pcall(function()
							descendant.Value = 100
						end) then
							n1 = n1 + 1
						end
					end

					if descendant:IsA("Tool") then
						for _, v2 in ipairs({
							"Recoil",
							"Spread",
							"MaxSpread",
							"MinSpread",
							"Bloom",
							"Deviation",
							"Kickback",
							"RecoilAmount",
							"Sway",
							"Accuracy"
						}) do
							if pcall(function()
								if v2 == "Accuracy" then
									descendant:SetAttribute(v2, 100)
								else
									descendant:SetAttribute(v2, 0)
								end
							end) then
								n1 = n1 + 1
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	v18("No Recoil", "Patched " .. n1 .. " values")
end

local function v47()
	local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if CurrentCamera then
		local vector2 = Vector2.new(CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2, CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
		local v50 = nil
		local FOVRadius = t1.FOVRadius or 150
		local v52 = Players
		local v53 = v50

		for _, player in ipairs(v52.GetPlayers(v52)) do
			local v56

			if player == LocalPlayer then
				v56 = false
			else
				v56 = player.Character
			end

			if v56 then
				local HumanoidRootPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild(t1.AimPart) or player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local Humanoid2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

				if HumanoidRootPart2 then
					if Humanoid2 then
						Humanoid2 = Humanoid2.Health > 0
					end
				else
					Humanoid2 = HumanoidRootPart2
				end

				if Humanoid2 then
					local v59, v60 = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(HumanoidRootPart2.Position)

					if v60 then
						local Magnitude = (Vector2.new(v59.X, v59.Y) - vector2).Magnitude

						if Magnitude < FOVRadius then
							if t1.Wallbang then
								v53 = player
								FOVRadius = Magnitude
							else
								local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

								raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
								raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

								local hit = workspace:Raycast(CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, HumanoidRootPart2.Position - CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, raycastParams)

								if hit then
									hit = not hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
								end

								if not hit then
									v53 = player
									FOVRadius = Magnitude
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return v53
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v64()
	local v65 = Players

	for _, player in ipairs(v65.GetPlayers(v65)) do
		local v68 = player ~= LocalPlayer

		if v68 then
			v68 = player.Character
		end

		if v68 then
			if t1.ESP then
				local v69 = t2[player]

				if v69 then
					v69 = t2[player].Parent ~= player.Character
				end

				if v69 then
					pcall(function()
						t2[player]:Destroy()
					end)
					t2[player] = nil
				end

				if t2[player] then
					t2[player].FillColor = t1.ESPColor

					local v70 = t2[player]
					local s1 = "DepthMode"
					local Chams = t1.Chams

					if Chams then
						Chams = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
					end

					v70[s1] = Chams or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
				else
					local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

					Highlight.FillColor = t1.ESPColor
					Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5

					local s2 = "DepthMode"
					local Chams = t1.Chams

					if Chams then
						Chams = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
					end

					Highlight[s2] = Chams or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
					Highlight.Parent = player.Character
					t2[player] = Highlight
				end

				if t1.NameTags then
					local Head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

					if Head then
						local KAT_NameTag = Head:FindFirstChild("KAT_NameTag")

						if not KAT_NameTag then
							KAT_NameTag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
							KAT_NameTag.Name = "KAT_NameTag"
							KAT_NameTag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
							KAT_NameTag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
							KAT_NameTag.AlwaysOnTop = true
							KAT_NameTag.Parent = Head

							local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

							TextLabel.Name = "Label"
							TextLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
							TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
							TextLabel.TextColor3 = t1.ESPColor
							TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
							TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
							TextLabel.TextSize = 14
							TextLabel.Parent = KAT_NameTag
						end

						local Label = KAT_NameTag:FindFirstChild("Label")

						if Label then
							local Humanoid2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
							local Position = HumanoidRootPart

							if Position then
								Position = Head.Position

								if Position then
									Position = (Head.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
								end
							end

							local v82 = Position or 0
							local s3 = "Text"
							local Name = player.Name
							local s4 = " ["
							local v86 = math.floor(v82)
							local s5 = "m]"

							if Humanoid2 then
								local Health = Humanoid2.Health

								Humanoid2 = " HP:" .. math.floor(Health)
							end

							Label[s3] = Name .. s4 .. v86 .. s5 .. (Humanoid2 or "")
							Label.TextColor3 = t1.ESPColor
						end
					end
				elseif player.Character then
					local ipairs_ = ipairs
					local Character2 = player.Character

					for _, descendant in ipairs_(Character2.GetDescendants(Character2)) do
						if descendant.Name == "KAT_NameTag" then
							pcall(function()
								descendant:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			else
				if t2[player] then
					local function v93()
						t2[player]:Destroy()
					end

					pcall(v93)
					t2[player] = nil
				end

				if player.Character then
					local ipairs_ = ipairs
					local Character2 = player.Character

					for _, descendant in ipairs_(Character2.GetDescendants(Character2)) do
						if descendant.Name == "KAT_NameTag" then
							pcall(function()
								descendant:Destroy()
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local v131 = v111:Section({
	Title = "Diagnostics",
	Box = true,
	Opened = true
})
local t11 = {
	Title = "Print State",
	Callback = function()
		local function v133()
			local t12 = {}

			for k, v in pairs(t1) do
				if typeof(v) == "Color3" then
					t12[k] = {
						R = v.R,
						G = v.G,
						B = v.B
					}
				else
					t12[k] = v
				end
			end

			return HttpService:JSONEncode(t12)
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(v133)

		if ok then
			print("[KAT] State:", result)
		else
			print("[KAT] State encode failed:", result)
		end

		v18("Debug", "Printed (F9)")
	end
}

v131.Button(v131, t11)

local t13 = {
	Title = "Inspect Equipped Tool",
	Desc = "Print tool children & attributes",
	Callback = function()
		local Tool = Character

		if Tool then
			Tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		end

		local GetAttributes, v142, v143, v144, v145

		if Tool then
			if Tool then
				print("[KAT] Tool:", Tool.Name, Tool.ClassName)
				print("[KAT] Attributes:")
				GetAttributes = Tool.GetAttributes
				v142, v143, v144 = pairs(GetAttributes(Tool))

				while true do
					v144, v145 = v142(v143, v144)

					if not v144 then
						break
					end

					print("  " .. v144 .. " = " .. tostring(v145))
				end

				print("[KAT] Children:")

				for _, descendant in ipairs(Tool.GetDescendants(Tool)) do
					print("  - " .. descendant:GetFullName() .. " (" .. descendant.ClassName .. ")")
				end

				v18("Debug", "Tool inspected (F9)")
			else
				v18("Debug", "No tool found")
			end

			return
		end

		local Backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")

		if not Backpack then
			if Tool then
				print("[KAT] Tool:", Tool.Name, Tool.ClassName)
				print("[KAT] Attributes:")
				GetAttributes = Tool.GetAttributes
				v142, v143, v144 = pairs(GetAttributes(Tool))

				while true do
					v144, v145 = v142(v143, v144)

					if not v144 then
						break
					end

					print("  " .. v144 .. " = " .. tostring(v145))
				end

				print("[KAT] Children:")

				for _, descendant in ipairs(Tool.GetDescendants(Tool)) do
					print("  - " .. descendant:GetFullName() .. " (" .. descendant.ClassName .. ")")
				end

				v18("Debug", "Tool inspected (F9)")
			else
				v18("Debug", "No tool found")
			end

			return
		end

		Tool = Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

		if Tool then
			print("[KAT] Tool:", Tool.Name, Tool.ClassName)
			print("[KAT] Attributes:")
			GetAttributes = Tool.GetAttributes
			v142, v143, v144 = pairs(GetAttributes(Tool))

			while true do
				v144, v145 = v142(v143, v144)

				if not v144 then
					break
				end

				print("  " .. v144 .. " = " .. tostring(v145))
			end

			print("[KAT] Children:")

			for _, descendant in ipairs(Tool.GetDescendants(Tool)) do
				print("  - " .. descendant:GetFullName() .. " (" .. descendant.ClassName .. ")")
			end

			v18("Debug", "Tool inspected (F9)")
		else
			v18("Debug", "No tool found")
		end
	end
}

v131.Button(v131, t13)

local t14 = {
	Title = "Scan Remotes",
	Desc = "List RemoteEvents/Functions",
	Callback = function()
		local t15 = {}

		for _, v in ipairs({ ReplicatedStorage, workspace }) do
			for _, descendant in ipairs(v.GetDescendants(v)) do
				if descendant:IsA("RemoteEvent") or descendant:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					table.insert(t15, descendant:GetFullName())
				end
			end
		end

		print("[KAT] Remotes (" .. #t15 .. "):")

		for _, v in ipairs(t15) do
			print("  - " .. v)
		end

		v18("Debug", #t15 .. " remotes (F9)")
	end
}

v131.Button(v131, t14)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local n2 = 15548269
	local v162 = not (Character and Character.Parent)

	if v162 then
		v162 = LocalPlayer.Character
	end

	if v162 then
		n2 = LocalPlayer.Character
		Character = n2
	end

	if Character then
		if not (Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent) then
			Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		end

		if not (HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPart.Parent) then
			HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		end
	end

	if Humanoid then
		Humanoid.WalkSpeed = t1.WalkSpeed
		Humanoid.JumpPower = t1.JumpPower

		if t1.NoRecoil then
			Humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

	if CurrentCamera then
		CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = t1.FOV
	end

	v37()

	local function v164()
		local v165 = TextButton
		local Aimbot = t1.Aimbot

		if not Aimbot then
			v165.BackgroundColor3 = Aimbot or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)

			return
		end

		Aimbot = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
		v165.BackgroundColor3 = Aimbot or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	end

	pcall(v164)

	local Aimbot = t1.Aimbot

	if Aimbot then
		Aimbot = not t1.AimbotRequireWeapon or v14()
	end

	if Aimbot then
		local v168 = v47()
		local Character2

		if v168 then
			Character2 = v168.Character
		else
			Character2 = v168
		end

		if Character2 then
			local HumanoidRootPart2 = v168.Character:FindFirstChild(t1.AimPart) or v168.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local v171

			if HumanoidRootPart2 then
				if CurrentCamera then
					v171 = HumanoidRootPart2.Position ~= CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
				else
					v171 = CurrentCamera
				end
			else
				v171 = HumanoidRootPart2
			end

			if v171 then
				local cFrame = CFrame.new(CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, HumanoidRootPart2.Position)
				local AimSmooth = t1.AimSmooth

				if AimSmooth then
					AimSmooth = t1.AimSmooth > 0
				end

				if AimSmooth then
					CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame:Lerp(cFrame, 1 / (t1.AimSmooth + 1))
				else
					CurrentCamera.CFrame = cFrame
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local Fly = t1.Fly

	if Fly then
		Fly = HumanoidRootPart and CurrentCamera
	end

	if Fly then
		local vector3 = Vector3.zero

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
			vector3 = vector3 + CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
			vector3 = vector3 - CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
			vector3 = vector3 - CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
			vector3 = vector3 + CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
			vector3 = vector3 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		end

		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
			vector3 = vector3 - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		end

		HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = vector3 * 60
	end

	if t1.HitboxExpand then
		local v176 = Players

		for _, player in ipairs(v176.GetPlayers(v176)) do
			local v179

			if player == LocalPlayer then
				v179 = false
			else
				v179 = player.Character
			end

			if v179 then
				local HumanoidRootPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if HumanoidRootPart2 then
					HumanoidRootPart2.Size = Vector3.new(t1.HitboxSize, t1.HitboxSize, t1.HitboxSize)
					HumanoidRootPart2.Transparency = 0.7
					HumanoidRootPart2.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end
	else
		local v181 = Players

		for _, player in ipairs(v181.GetPlayers(v181)) do
			local v184

			if player == LocalPlayer then
				v184 = false
			else
				v184 = player.Character
			end

			if v184 then
				local HumanoidRootPart2 = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if HumanoidRootPart2 then
					HumanoidRootPart2.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
					HumanoidRootPart2.Transparency = 1
					HumanoidRootPart2.CanCollide = true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local AntiVoid = t1.AntiVoid

	if AntiVoid then
		AntiVoid = HumanoidRootPart

		if AntiVoid then
			AntiVoid = HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y < -50
		end
	end

	if AntiVoid then
		HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(HumanoidRootPart.Position.X, 50, HumanoidRootPart.Position.Z)
	end

	local BunnyHop = t1.BunnyHop

	if BunnyHop then
		BunnyHop = Humanoid
	end

	if not (BunnyHop and Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air) then
		return
	end

	Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
end)

		InfiniteJump = Humanoid
	end

	if not InfiniteJump then
		return
	end

	Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	task.wait(1)
	Humanoid2 = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	if not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	if not Humanoid2 then
		return
	end

	Humanoid2.WalkSpeed = t1.WalkSpeed
	Humanoid2.JumpPower = t1.JumpPower
end)
